# Number rounding tool

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/number-rounder/

Round a finite number to a chosen number of decimal places, or apply a floor or ceiling at that precision. Compare the output with the input.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Round 123.4567 to two decimal places for a clean displayed value.

## Limits and checks

Calculations use browser floating-point arithmetic. Financial systems may apply a specific decimal or bankers-rounding policy.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
